Large medical-white crown plate, white cheek guards, DARK OPAQUE SMOKED FULL VISOR down across eyes and nose with a cold-grey glint, black lower breathing guard, dark ear housing. One narrow muted blue band around brow, one TINY cyan rectangular status light beside visible ear (only 2-3 native pixels), one broad blank side plate for a later hand-placed 9x9 tower logo. Do NOT draw a logo, text, badge or emblem. No rail, goggles, face, horns, spikes, military real emblems. Distinct from all-grey field helmets: bright WHITE plates should be obvious. Clean industrial issue gear, bold almost-black outlines, top-left lighting, chunky flat painted pixel-friendly planes with 4-5 value steps; no fine engraving, scratches, gradients, dithering or tiny dots. Intended reduction 72x72 px: simple large readable shapes, entire helmet fills 80% square canvas. Single object centered, no extra objects.
